'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine]] lowers the age of [[conscription]] from 27 years to 25. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/03/ukraine-military-draft-age-law (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/04/03/world/europe/zelensky-ukraine-military-draft-age.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[United States Army Corps of Engineers]] begins [[dredging]] the [[San Juan Bay]] in [[Puerto Rico]] to open space for a new [[natural-gas processing|natural gas terminal]] that is expected to add [[USD|$]]400 million to the [[Economy of Puerto Rico|local economy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/puerto-rico-san-juan-bay-dredging-environment-0a6a0c0cd0e197c0fb32593e0ca567e1 (AP News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Hualien earthquake]]
**A magnitude 7.4 [[List of earthquakes in Taiwan|earthquake]] strikes off the coast of [[Taiwan]], prompting [[tsunami]] warnings for [[Okinawa Prefecture]], [[Japan]]. A large section of the uninhabited [[Guishan Island (Yilan)|Guishan Island]] collapses into the ocean. Nine people are killed in Taiwan, including four by [[rockfall]]s, with more than 930 others injured. [https://apnews.com/article/taiwan-earthquake-tsunami-f086aac0c3082036d1ca77c01828fb28 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/4/3/taiwan-7-5-earthquake-live-tsunami-warnings-in-japan-philippines-taiwan (Al Jazeera)]
*Seven people, including two children are killed in a fire at a tailoring shop in [[Aurangabad]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-fire-tailoring-shop-mararashtra-3eaf225df7a1ec461a75c6f6902ba855 (AP News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Philippines relations]], [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**The [[Philippines]] says that it will respond to any [[China|Chinese]] attempts to interfere with its resupply of troops in the [[South China Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-says-it-is-committed-maintaining-position-second-thomas-shoal-2024-04-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**The [[Ministry of National Defense (Republic of China)|National Defense Ministry]] of [[Taiwan]] says that more than 30 [[China|Chinese]] [[People's Liberation Army Air Force|PLA Air Force]] warplanes have entered Taiwanese airspace and that at least nine [[People's Liberation Army Navy|PLA Navy]] warships have been detected around Taiwan. The [[Republic of China Armed Forces|ROC Armed Forces]] are deployed in response to the violation. [https://www.timesnownews.com/world/asia/over-30-chinese-warplanes-9-navy-vessels-around-taiwan-report-article-108989298 (Times Now News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[LGBT rights in Uganda]]
**[[Uganda]]'s [[Court of Appeal of Uganda|Constitutional Court]] upholds the [[Anti-Homosexuality Act, 2023]], which prescribes the [[death penalty]] for certain homosexual acts. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/africa/article/3257708/uganda-top-court-declines-block-controversial-anti-gay-law-sees-some-rights-infringed?module=Africa&pgtype=section (''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Businesswoman [[Sam Mostyn]] is appointed as the next [[Governor General of Australia]] and will succeed [[David Hurley]] on 1 July. [https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/8578505/sam-mostyn-named-as-australias-28th-governor-general/ (''Canberra Times'')]
